Features

Everything a reading team needs

Linked by meaning

Each note is matched to related notes as you type, without tags or folders.

Sources kept

Quotes carry their page number and edition, ready for a bibliography.

Shared shelves

Put a set of notes on a shelf and the whole team reads along.

Works offline

Write on a train; Quillfern syncs when you are back.

See the shape of what you've read

The map view lays out every note by how closely they relate, so clusters you never planned appear on their own.

Questions

Can I import from other apps?

Yes. Markdown folders and most note apps' exports come in with their links.

Where are my notes stored?

On servers in the EU, encrypted at rest, and on your own devices.
